mapper.insert: INSERT INTO bk_delivery_address (address_id, user_id, recipient, phone, zip_code, address1, address2, is_default) VALUES (#{addressId}, #{userId}, #{recipient}, #{phone}, #{zipCode}, #{address1}, #{address2}, #{isDefault})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM bk_delivery_address WHERE address_id = #{addressId} AND user_id = #{userId}
